summary: Fleet Cleaner. Not found in the IND sponsor register. 100% of its 1 jobs here don't ask for Dutch.
sources: IND public register (work / highly skilled migrants), fetched 2026-10-06, https://ind.nl/en/public-register-recognised-sponsors/public-register-regular-labour-and-highly-skilled-migrants
Google News RSS (headline and link only), last 90 days, fetched 2026-10-06

insights.one_liner: Delft maritime tech company (now presenting as Fleet Robotics) building robots that clean and inspect ship hulls; pay shown, but not an IND recognised sponsor.

culture.text: Develops robots for underwater inspection, cleaning and maintenance of ships, helping shipowners cut fuel use and emissions.
Works daily in some of the world's largest ports; its open entry-level operations job is based in Delft.

open.text: Not listed as an IND recognised sponsor, so it cannot sponsor a highly skilled migrant visa.
Its open entry-level operations role in Delft needs no Dutch and shows the salary.

worth_knowing.text: The job posting introduces the company as Fleet Robotics rather than Fleet Cleaner.
